name: multi-model-review
description: Review code or a draft with other AI models (OpenAI Codex, Cursor CLI, Google Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI or Claude CLI), run locally and read-only: a panel of fresh reviewers, or a back-and-forth dialogue with one model that keeps its session. Claude checks every claim, revises between rounds and tracks token use. Also an orchestrator: Claude hands plan tasks to other models, each writing only in its own git worktree, and commits each task with the agent that did it.
